messages:
Ava (Infra): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread — a few people asked about region prioritization and the GPU pipeline timing, so dropping the answers here and open for questions.

Marcus (SRE): Do we have a firm order for region rollouts? EMEA vs APAC vs US-west?

Ava (Infra): Short answer: US-east (primary), then EMEA (Q2), then APAC (early Q3). Dependent on supply + cloud partner windows. We're locking EMEA capacity this month.

Priya (Product): Will this affect dedicated customers in EMEA who requested earlier capacity? Any compensation/priority?

Ava (Infra): We're honoring committed Dedicated contracts — dedicated pools get priority allocations. For new requests we'll triage by SLA tier and usage pattern. cc @Marcus for process.

Marcus (SRE): For the autoscaler, are we changing thresholds to prefer local-region burst vs fallback cross-region? I remember some concerns about latency.

Jin (Runtime Eng): Yes — autoscaler policy updated to prefer local buffer until 85% util, then allow cross-region bursting if latency budget allows. Fallback rules:

````
policy:
  local_threshold: 0.85
  cross_region_allowed: true
  max_cross_region_p99_ms: 120
````

Marcus (SRE): Cool. How strict is that 120ms p99? Is it configurable per-customer?

Jin (Runtime Eng): It's a soft cap. Enterprise customers can set overrides in Dedicated config. Hosted API will use per-route latency profiles.

Priya (Product): Any ETA on the autoscaler rollout? We should sync with Console to show "bursting allowed" flags for routes.

Ava (Infra): Autoscaler config will start Canary next week (Mon). Full rollout by end of month assuming no regressions. Console flag work is on track — @Priya we'll add a small banner for affected routes.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for autoscaler v1.4 — canary group: 2% traffic — logs at https://ci.redwood/example-canary

Marcus (SRE): What about GPU types — are we switching to more A100 vs H100 in EMEA? That impacts perf profiles.

Ava (Infra): Short term: mix of A100 and H100; H100s ramp later this quarter. We'll publish model performance deltas in the catalog so engineers can pick preferred variant.

Jin (Runtime Eng): Note on KV cache behavior when bursting cross-region: we do prefix-aware caching, but cold-start tokens will still pay latency. Recommend enabling local prefix cache for chat-heavy routes.

Priya (Product): Action: update launch checklist to include a "bursting behavior" note and add a support KB article. I'll take it.

Ava (Infra): Thanks — we'll follow up with a postmortem-style doc if canary shows issues. Any other Qs? :thumbsup:

Marcus (SRE): One last — procurement timeline for extra capacity?

Ava (Infra): Procurement signed for EMEA buffer by 2076810000 (approx two weeks). If anything shifts I'll update here.

Priya (Product): :thumbsup:

Jin (Runtime Eng): Happy to demo autoscaler canary logs to anyone tomorrow 11am PT.

Marcus (SRE): I'll join. 

Ava (Infra): Great — thanks all. Closing the thread for now; feel free to ping me directly for follow-ups. :wave:
